status: EMPTY. No authorised first-party report has been received, so there are no rows.
rule: A row is added only from an authorised first-party report, with the timestamp, source, channel, eligible sessions, clicks, and reported orders copied from that report. No estimates, third-party figures, or forecasts are entered.

columns.name: timestamp_utc
columns.meaning: When the figure was copied from the report (UTC).

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Name of the report and where it came from.

columns.name: channel
columns.meaning: Where the traffic came from, for example guide:<slug> or product:<id>.

columns.name: eligible_sessions
columns.meaning: Sessions the report counts as eligible.

columns.name: provenance_url
columns.meaning: Official page the figure came from.
